requirements.evidence: Migrations match the spec: `slug` unique 'entities_slug_unique' + softDeletes (create_entities_table.php:17-19); stored generated `owner_seq` + unique 'entity_memberships_one_owner' and 'entity_memberships_entity_user_unique' (create_entity_memberships_table.php:21-27). Policies follow the rules (EntityPolicy.php, EntityMembershipPolicy.php:33-44 owner never removable, last manager blocked, self-removal allowed). EntityController::pick authorizes 'view' before writing the session and logs to the 'audit' channel. Members validates `exists:users,email`, raises the duplicate error on 'email' (AddEntityMember.php:27), restricts roles to UserRole::manageable() (Members.php:68-70). Settings locks `$entity`, ignores its own id in the slug unique rule, deletes memberships, clears a matching session, and transfers ownership in a locked transaction (TransferEntityOwnership.php:26-48) that returns 403 for a non-admin, the caller themselves, a foreign target or a missing owner row. Routes, contract methods, factories with states, lang keys in both locales and the docs/database-schema.md update are all present.

conventions.evidence: Every domain write goes through a single-use-case class in app/Actions (AddEntityMember, SetEntityMemberRole, RemoveEntityMember, UpdateEntity, DeleteEntity, TransferEntityOwnership), and each one authorizes through Gate::forUser. Members uses #[Validate] on `email` (Members.php:28). Models declare #[Fillable]. Repeated markup is a Blade component (components/entity-tabs.blade.php). CHANGELOG and docs/database-schema.md are updated and public methods have PHPDoc. Small deviations: Settings validates through `rules()` and `assignRole` uses an inline `Validator::validate`, not #[Validate] (both acceptable under the policy's 'or a rules() method'). The migrations look generated (timestamped names, reversible down()).

security.evidence: `#[Locked] public Entity $entity` in all three components, with tests that the entity cannot be swapped. Every public action calls `$this->authorize` and the action authorizes again. Membership ids passed as parameters are resolved only within the bound entity (`membershipOf`, Members.php:94-101) and then authorized. The transfer target is scoped with `$entity->memberships()->whereKey(...)` under lockForUpdate. Adding a member is rate-limited (Members.php:44-50). Views use only `{{ }}`. Fillable is set deliberately. The settings link is hidden from non-owners with @can('manageSettings').

tests.evidence: Pest tests: EntityModelTest (indexes by name, DB rejects a second owner/duplicate member, owner_seq values, relations, cascades), EntityPolicyTest (every ability for every role plus a manager of another entity), EntityPickTest (403 with the session untouched, audit line, guest/unverified), EntityDashboardTest (owner notice, no settings link for admin/employee, session pointing at another entity is not enough), EntityMembersTest and EntitySettingsTest (happy paths, validation failures, unauthorized calls to every action, tamper tests for the locked entity and foreign membership ids, the owner row vanishing before transfer). Minor: the 'owner row vanished' test is stopped by the manageSettings check, so it never reaches the action's own `$owner === null` branch.

simplicity.evidence: The code is direct and reuses existing pieces (x-form-field, x-button, policies, UserRole::isManager). Some duplication: each Livewire action runs `$this->authorize(...)` and the Action authorizes the same ability again (e.g. Members.php:66 + SetEntityMemberRole.php:23; Settings.php:39 + UpdateEntity.php:19). Role validation also happens twice (Members.php:68-70 and SetEntityMemberRole.php:25-27). Both are defensible as defense in depth.

readability.evidence: Methods are small and well named (`membershipOf`, `managerCount`, `isManager`). PHPDoc explains the intent, e.g. the comment 'Demote first so the (entity_id, owner_seq) unique index never sees two owners' in TransferEntityOwnership.php. Style matches the Laravel siblings and there is no dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: Almost everything serves the task. Small additions beyond the spec: a rate limit on addMember, audit logs for member, role, delete and transfer actions, an `entity-tabs` component with a `nav_dashboard` tab, and a LocaleKeysTest. None of these touch out-of-scope areas (no onboarding, switcher, middleware or navbar changes).

issues.location: tests/Feature/EntitySettingsTest.php ('a transfer is forbidden once the caller is no longer the owner')
issues.explanation: Deleting the owner's membership makes the component-level `manageSettings` check fail first, so the action's `$owner === null` branch under lockForUpdate is never exercised.
The duplicate check is a check-then-insert with no transaction, so two concurrent adds hit the unique index and surface as a 500 QueryException, not a validation error on 'email'.
Authorization and role validation are repeated in both the component and the Action; one place (the Action) would be enough.
The rate limit on addMember and the extra audit logs on member actions were not requested, though they are consistent with the security policy.
The `int $membershipId` type hints mean a non-numeric value from the client causes a TypeError (500), not a clean 403/validation error.

review.summary: The change adds the entity and membership schema (with the portable one-owner generated column), policies, the pick endpoint and three Livewire pages backed by per-use-case Actions, with docs, both locales and an extensive Pest suite that includes unauthorized-call and tamper tests. Requirements, security and tests are essentially complete. The only issues are small: some duplicated authorization and validation, a few unrequested extras, and one test that does not reach the branch it targets, so it is approvable with nits.
